keyPoints.text: Quillfeather's turnaround on orders is now three working days, down from five.
keyPoints.quote: Our average turnaround on your orders is now three working days, down from five in the summer.

keyPoints.text: Quillfeather's prices rise by four percent from 1 January and Rosa accepted it.
keyPoints.quote: From the first of January our prices go up by four percent across the board.

keyPoints.text: From the new year brochures move onto a recycled stock as standard.
keyPoints.quote: from the new year we are moving all your brochures onto a recycled stock as standard.

risks.text: Two October invoices charged the old rate and are still not fixed.
risks.quote: It's not fixed yet. Our accounts team are still looking at it.

risks.text: A paper shortage in the spring could double lead times on heavier paper.
risks.quote: lead times could double on the heavier paper. It's not certain.

traps.what: A second supplier is only a vague 'at some point'. Not an action.
traps.quote: We should probably think about it, yes. At some point. Not now.
Somebody ought to check the contract renewal date too, I think it's in the spring.

traps.what: Jim's hedged offer was released ('Only if you get a minute').
traps.quote: I might email legal about that, though I've got a lot on.

traps.what: Samples will come 'at some point' with no owner or date; not an action.
traps.quote: We'll send samples at some point.
